messages:
santiago: Canary automation stalled in eu-west-1 — Flagger/Argo-rollouts stuck at 30% for >90m, never promoted. Seen admission webhook 5xx from `model-admit.prod.svc` and Helm release revisions differ between clusters. Can someone triage?
amelia: Which rollout name and cluster?
santiago: rollout async-infer-v2 in prod-eu. Deploy logs show: 
```
Status: Progressing
Condition: Healthy=false (Reason: AdmissionWebhookError, message: "webhook call failed: context deadline exceeded")
```
deploy-bot: CI/Helm command that ran: `helm upgrade --install async-infer-v2 ./charts/async -n prod --values values-eu.yaml --atomic` — release revision 7 on eu, controller expected rev 6 (gitops-sync thought nothing changed).
lin: Checking infra — terraform state drift on prod-eu nodepool labels. `terraform plan` shows label `gpu.present = true` missing in cloud resource (so autoscaler didn't pick GPU nodes). Possibly TF workspace drift after a failed apply earlier.
ryan: Also saw 3 spot GPU preemptions in eu-west-1 in last 2h. Cluster-autoscaler couldn't roll up on-demand because kube-scheduler blocked due to nodeAffinity in chart: `nodeSelector: { gpu: "true" }` but new machines come up without label.
meera: Argo Rollouts health checks remained Unknown because the admission webhook returned 500s, so the canary never reached the `healthy` state to proceed. Rollout automation treats Unknown/Degraded as hold, not rollback.
amelia: Quick workaround: manually promote so traffic isn't stuck. Use: `kubectl argo rollouts promote async-infer-v2 -n prod` — that worked for me, traffic bumped to 100% for eu cluster.
santiago: Manual promote succeeded, but we need a permanent fix so automation doesn't get stuck and we don't silently diverge between clusters.
ops-bot: Observability note: gitops-sync skipped eu because secret `git-creds-prod-eu` was missing for 8m during the initial sync window; helm-defaults in values-eu.yaml and values-us.yaml differ (tolerations present in us, missing in eu).
lin: Root cause hypothesis: sequence: (1) partial GitOps sync due to secret transient error -> helm release diff -> (2) TF drift removed GPU label from nodepool -> new nodes lacked label so scheduler couldn't place pods -> webhook backed up (resource pressure) -> rollouts stuck.
ryan: Cost tradeoff: if we force on-demand to avoid spot churn we'll increase cost ~2.3x for this family. Should be a documented SLO vs cost decision.
meera: Proposed short-term fixes: 
- add tolerations for `nvidia.com/gpu` taint to chart defaults so pods can tolerate both tainted and untainted nodes (quick PR to charts).
- make Argo Rollouts treat webhook 5xx as transient with retry, not permanent hold; add a timeout fallback that alerts on human approval after X minutes.
- add a CI guard that runs `terraform plan` against remote state and fails PRs when drift is detected (GH action).
amelia: Example chart snippet to add now (PR incoming):
```yaml
tolerations:
  - key: "nvidia.com/gpu"
    operator: "Exists"
    effect: "NoSchedule"
```
deploy-bot: Also adding a GitOps sync retry for secrets errors (backoff) — current controller gives up after 1 attempt inside our sync window. Changing to 5 retries with jitter.
lin: I'll open INF ticket: INF-2021 "canary stuck due to webhook + tf drift" and attach logs/plan. I'll also push a small chart PR adding tolerations and a values schema note.
santiago: For followup: add a chaos test in staging that simulates webhook timeouts and spot preemptions to ensure rollback/promote behavior is sane.
ryan: I'll write a short cost memo comparing on-demand vs mixed spot for eu GPU pool and propose a temporary on-demand burst window for Canary periods.
meera: Also: add `progressDeadlineSeconds` reduction to make automation fail faster if rollout is unhealthy for Xm (but pair with auto-fallback to baseline model to avoid traffic impact).
amelia: After PRs, we should run a dry canary in staging with forced webhook failure to validate the new fallback behaviors.
santiago: Thanks — summary action items: lin -> INF ticket + chart PR; meera -> rollout health timeout change + staging test; ryan -> cost memo; deploy-bot -> increase gitops retry/backoff; ops-bot -> create alert for helm release revision divergence. I'll follow up in the ticket.
